title: Damon Lindelof Details His Scrapped 'Star Wars'
text:
Not so long ago in a galaxy not that far away, Damon Lindelof was plotting to leave his mark on the 'Star Wars' universe.

And let’s do the Protestant Reformation inside Star Wars. And it didn’t work. ”Although he things Lucasfilm “seemed to like the premise,” Lindelof thinks his concept “didn’t feel necessarily that risky. ” “The writing was really hard, it was slow — the tone, getting it right,” he explained.
“Where it was inside of the canon, what its relationship was with to Episode IX, is it starting a new trilogy? ” Lindelof added, “It’s the old sort of like tanker equation, which is, you turn the wheel and it takes five minutes before it turns a little bit.
